issuer.name: Monovate (spelling as on the FAQ; region of the statement not specified)

funding.supported_assets_note: The card draws on tokens the user delegates from a self-custodial MetaMask wallet under a spending cap; tokens are converted to fiat at the time of each transaction. Delegable tokens per the getting-started page: Linea (mUSD, USDC, USDT, wETH, EURe, GBPe), Solana (USDC, USDT), Base (USDC, USDT), Monad (USDC); mUSD from a linked Money Account.

variants.region_label: International (26 EEA countries, UK, CH, Crown dependencies, Latin America, Canada, Gulf)

eligibility.usage_note: The 'What is MetaMask Card?' support page lists 48 eligible countries by name (ISO mapping is ours). Czechia, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania are NOT on the list. United States: 'not currently available for sign-ups', waitlist only (existing US holders keep their cards). Proof of residency is required to sign up; 'ineligible regions limit sign-ups, not spending'. Undated page.

kyc.stages_note: Sign-up: e-mail + password, phone confirmation, then KYC run by the programme manager Crypto Life (privacy policy hosted by Baanx); 'proof of residency is required to sign up'. The exact identity documents (ID type, selfie) are not listed on any page read. No credit check (debit product).

access.note: 'The Virtual card is free to use, with no yearly fees.' Annual subscription $0 in the fee table.

fees.conditions: No issuance line in the fee table; the virtual card is described as 'free to use' but a one-off issuance fee is neither stated nor denied.
Fee table: annual subscription $0 for the Free tier; 'no annual fees or maintenance fees'.
'Delegating funds for spending: no fee, no minimum balance.' Network gas applies at spend (typically about $0.01–0.02 on Linea, variable; Monad gas sponsored).

Worst case modelled. Fee table by token: stablecoin in the cardholder's local currency 0%; stablecoin in the merchant's local currency 0%; stablecoin in a currency matching neither 0.5% (Argentina exception); DeFi/tokenised-yield tokens (e.g. aUSDC) 0% up to $1,200/month then 0.5%; other crypto (e.g. wETH) 0.875%.
'Foreign transaction (cross-border)': 1%, charged when the merchant is outside the cardholder's country.
2% per withdrawal; the ATM operator may charge an extra fee.

rewards.conditions: 'Card transactions earn 1% mUSD back on all eligible transactions'; 'eligible' is not defined on the pages read. Claimed from the Money Account (MetaMask Mobile) or the card dashboard; payout frequency not stated. The pages read were displayed with the region selector on 'United States'; whether the same rate applies to all 48 eligible countries is not stated. Separate US-only Blackbird dining rewards ($FLY) and a travel offer (4% + 1% mUSD via Entravel) are not modelled.

limits.note: $10,000 per transaction; $15,000 per day (amounts stated in USD).
$1,000 per transaction and per day; ATM network limits may apply.

access.note: Annual membership $199, auto-renewing, cancellable; 14-day full refund on the order. 'Orders for the MetaMask Metal card are temporarily paused as of June 2nd, 2026' — not available to new users; existing holders keep their benefits.

Same token ladder as the Free tier (0% local-currency stablecoins, 0.5% other-currency stablecoins, 0.875% other crypto).

No fee up to $1,200 per month, then 2%; ATM operator fees may apply.

rewards.conditions: 1% mUSD back after the first $10,000 spent each year. Region caveat as for the Free tier.
3% mUSD back on the first $10,000 spent each year (cap of $300/year is our calculation: 3% × $10,000), then 1%. Metal orders paused since 2 June 2026.

evidence.excerpt: Free / Metal: annual $0 / $199; replacement n/a / $99; FX 1% / none (fair usage); ATM 2% / free to $1,200/month then 2%. Token fees: local-currency stablecoin 0%; mismatched-currency stablecoin 0.5%; DeFi tokens free to $1,200/month then 0.5%; other crypto 0.875%; delegation free; gas ≈ $0.01. Limits $10k/tx $15k/day (Free), $20k/tx $30k/day (Metal); ATM $1k/tx, $1k or $5k/day.

changelog.reason: Initial record (unattended research run) from seven support-centre articles. Single read; second read ≥24 h later required before publication. All articles were served with the region selector on 'United States'; region-specific wording for EEA/UK cardholders could not be displayed by the fetcher, so the issuer and the reward rate are kept as hypotheses. metamask.io/card redirects to metamask.com/card, which could not be fetched (provenance rule). The 'manage-crypto/card/using' URL returned an empty canonical stub (not counted as a read).

editorial.summary: Self-custodial Mastercard debit card drawing on tokens delegated from a MetaMask wallet, converted at spend. Virtual card with no annual fee, 1% foreign-transaction fee, 2% ATM fee, 0–0.875% conversion fee depending on the token, 1% mUSD back. Available in 48 countries incl. most of the EEA (not CZ/EE/LV/LT), UK and Switzerland; the $199/year Metal tier (3% back on the first $10,000, no FX fee) has had orders paused since June 2026.
good_for: Self-custody users who hold stablecoins (EURe/GBPe/USDC) on Linea, Base, Solana or Monad
Everyday spending in the cardholder's own currency with local-currency stablecoins (0% conversion fee stated)
not_for: Residents of Czechia, Estonia, Latvia or Lithuania (not on the eligibility list)
Anyone wanting the Metal tier today (orders paused since 2 June 2026)
Frequent ATM users on the free tier (2% per withdrawal, no free allowance)
watch_outs: Every support page read was displayed for the United States region; EEA/UK-specific wording (issuer of record, reward eligibility) could not be confirmed — issuer and rewards are hypotheses.
The issuer is named only as 'Monovate' on the FAQ; no licence or regulated entity is stated for the EEA/UK.
Fees and limits are stated in USD even for non-US cardholders; the variant currency EUR is editorial.
'Eligible transactions' for the 1% mUSD back is not defined; payout frequency not stated.
mUSD is MetaMask's own stablecoin — rewards are paid in a token, not fiat.
